products.name: CoCounsel (Casetext)
products.note: Legal research AI; litigation support; Westlaw integration; attorney work product risk

profile_text.body:
Thomson Reuters is a publicly traded global content and technology company, listed on the Nasdaq and TSX under the ticker TRI, that describes itself as delivering purpose-built technology to professionals in legal, tax, trade, risk, and government sectors. The company positions its offerings around what it calls "Fiduciary-Grade AI," grounding its tools in authoritative content, domain expertise, and data governance. Its product portfolio includes CoCounsel, a legal AI product built on Westlaw and Practical Law content that supports research, analysis, drafting, and litigation workflows, and ONESOURCE+, a connected platform bringing together tax, trade, legal, and risk functions. The site notes that a firm called Justly Prudent used CoCounsel and Westlaw AI and reported increasing litigation capacity by 100%. In August 2026, Thomson Reuters announced the launch of Thomson, described as its first proprietary large language model developed in-house.

The company also publishes annual research on AI adoption, including the Future of Professionals Report 2026 and the 2026 AI in Professional Services Report, the latter drawing on perspectives from more than 1,500 professionals across legal, tax, accounting, risk, fraud, and government sectors. Those reports describe AI as now embedded in professional work and identify a growing gap between organizations achieving measurable impact and those falling behind. Thomson Reuters holds a CIK of 0001124954 with the SEC, confirming its status as a public company, and the site tracks CoCounsel, originally associated with Casetext, as its primary AI product in the finance and legal category.
